name: engineering-assembly
description: Directory of popular Claude Code extensions including development and productivity tools.

plugins.name: implementation
plugins.description: A structured validation workflow for software development tasks, plus QA test automation and JIRA integration. Validates requirement completeness, runs manual test cases on web (playwright-cli) or Android (adb) via the automation-expert agent, and retrieves/posts results to JIRA tickets.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Bundles the Context7 MCP server (https://mcp.context7.com/mcp) so Claude Code can pull up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples on demand.

plugins.name: atlassian-sso
plugins.description: Bundles the Atlassian Remote MCP Server (Rovo) so Claude Code can access Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, and Compass via OAuth 2.1 SSO login.

plugins.name: atlassian-api-token
plugins.description: Bundles the Atlassian Remote MCP Server (Rovo) so Claude Code can access Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, and Compass using a personal API token (Basic auth) instead of interactive SSO login.

plugins.name: work-journal
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for long-running work: append-only diary (LOG) and decision (DEC) logs under .claude/memory, grouped by work item (JIRA-123, RFC-7, …), with derived open-item tracking so any later session can answer what is still pending, what changed on a ticket, and what was done since a date. Ships its own clock-in/clock-out protocol via a UserPromptSubmit hook.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Repo-wide git housekeeping before the first prompt of every session, for any git repository. At SessionStart it fetches every branch and tag from the remote and prunes stale branch and tag refs, so remote-tracking refs are aligned with the remote before the agent starts. It also simulates GitHub feature-branch protection: a PreToolUse hook blocks any git push that would update main or master directly on the remote, telling the agent to push a non-main/master branch and open a pull request. A SessionStart hook injects a standing instruction that the git repository and its forge resources are the Single Source of Truth and win over any conflicting session context, that commits are the work diary, and that a commit carrying a key decision must capture the rationale in its message. The fetch runs synchronously at SessionStart, does nothing outside a git repo, never fails a session, and turns off when GIT_PLUGIN_DISABLE is non-empty. The latest launch status is kept per session under the OS temp dir and reported on demand by the read-only launch-status skill.

plugins.name: git-autosync
plugins.description: Puts a working tree into attached mode before the first prompt of every session, network-free: it reads the remote-tracking refs the companion git plugin fetches and never fetches the superproject itself. Only when the root repo is on a branch (detached HEAD is a no-op), it fast-forwards that branch to the remote's default branch (main, falling back to master), then populates each top-level submodule one level deep, attaches it to a branch named after the superproject's branch instead of a detached HEAD, and fast-forwards it to the superproject's recorded gitlink. Fast-forward only - a diverged branch is left as is. Waits on the git plugin's fetch barrier, injects one attached-mode summary line for the agent, does nothing outside a git repo or in a repo with no remote, never fails a session, and turns off when GIT_AUTOSYNC_DISABLE is non-empty. Bundles read-only launch-status and recap skills. Built for projects driven through Claude Code Remote Sessions.
